name: FORMA Project #3 - Drainage Pipe to Hidden Forest Home

concept.title: Giant Concrete Drainage Pipe -> Hidden Luxury Forest Home
concept.summary: One builder turns an abandoned 4 m precast concrete drainage pipe into a hidden forest home: clear the site and muck out the pipe, lay a utility line, waterproof it, build a level floor, frame and insulate the interior, glaze the front, finish the interior, add an entrance deck, then berm it into the hillside so only the glass front, deck and a band of concrete rim show.
concept.restarted: 2026-10-27: 4 m pipe, 10 stages; the 3 m chain is R&D in rnd/2026-10-26_pipe_3m/

budget.note: Reset to $0 at the 2026-10-27 restart: nothing paid until the new CP01 and plan are approved and a production budget is set deliberately. $0.6388 of 3 m still R&D is carried in the manifest.

stills.note: Default workflow: make each still in ChatGPT from its brief (Copy ChatGPT Brief; attach the previous approved still for every still after CP01), upload it on the still panel, review, approve - the Studio opens the next still. fal generation is an optional paid fallback per still (cheap Nano Banana Edit for simple edits, Nano Banana 2 Edit via model_overrides for large-area removals, Pro only if that fails); it is blocked while the project is paused or the cap is $0.

bibles.location: a pine and fern forest at the foot of a wooded slope, soft overcast daylight; open bare-earth ground to the left of the pipe, a dirt forest track entering at the left edge
bibles.structure: exactly one standalone precast concrete drainage pipe section, about 4 m inside diameter and about 13 m long, on its side along the foot of the slope - big enough to become a small luxury home; never joined to other sections or continuing into the forest; front opening and rear rim both visible; the builder reaches only about 40-45% of the opening height; the same pipe, size and position in every shot
bibles.builder: dark beard, olive beanie, rust-orange work jacket, grey canvas work pants, brown boots, work gloves - working, never posing
bibles.materials: everything arrives on the flatbed trailer on the forest track and waits in the material yard on the open ground at the left until it is used; removed debris and soil go to piles at the left

cameras.wide: raised about 7-8 m, high three-quarter view from the front-left (track side) with strong depth: the whole pipe from its front opening (nearest, lower right, facing the camera) to its rear end's circular rim (upper middle); track and open ground left, wooded slope right - the same camera position and framing in every wide shot
cameras.interior: inside the pipe just behind the front opening, chest height, looking along its whole length to the rear end
cameras.front: ground level straight on to the front opening from about 8 m, the full 4 m circle in frame
cameras.reveal: farther back down the forest track at about 35 m, low, the bermed hillside and the glowing glass front in the trees

checkpoints.title: Abandoned pipe discovered
checkpoints.state: Exactly one standalone giant precast concrete drainage pipe section - about 4 m inside diameter, about 13 m long, weathered grey with moss streaks and a chipped rim - lies abandoned on its side along the foot of the wooded slope. Its front opening faces the camera and its rear end's circular rim is visible at the far end; no other sections, nothing continuing into the forest. Leaf litter and brush lie around the pipe, a long fallen branch lies on the ground in front of the opening among natural loose sticks, and dark silt covers the pipe floor. The builder, beside the front opening, reaches only about 40-45% of its height. To the left the open bare ground and the forest track are untouched.
checkpoints.action: has just pushed the wheelbarrow in from the track, set it down at the pipe's track-side flank near the front, and looks up at the opening
tools_in_view: wheelbarrow at the track-side flank holding a rake, a bow saw and a shovel
not_yet: any construction work or building materials

checkpoints.title: Front and flank cleared
checkpoints.state: The fallen branch, the leaf litter and the brush are gone from in front of the opening and from the strip between the pipe and the track: that ground is raked to bare brown soil. The branch now lies as three sawn lengths stacked on the bare ground at the left beside the track, the bow saw on top of them; everything raked up sits in one low brush pile next to the stack. The wheelbarrow, with the shovel in it, still stands in its CP01 place at the track-side flank; the rake leans against the pipe. Dark silt still covers the pipe floor.
checkpoints.action: rakes the last leaves off the bare strip toward the brush pile
tools_in_view: bow saw on the stacked lengths

materials.cleared ground around the pipe: litter and brush raked to the brush pile at the left beside the track; the branch sawn and stacked there

not_yet: any construction work or building materials

checkpoints.title: First load tipped - mucking out under way
checkpoints.state: A small new dark spoil pile of silt sits on the bare ground at the left, next to the brush pile and separate from the three stacked sawn lengths; the emptied wheelbarrow stands tipped up beside it. Inside the pipe the silt patch keeps its shape but is shorter at the front: clean grey concrete nearest the rim, the rest of the dark silt untouched. The shovel leans against the pipe rim; the rake leans against the pipe.
checkpoints.action: tips the last of the silt out of the wheelbarrow onto the new spoil pile
not_yet: silt removed from the rest of the pipe floor

checkpoints.title: Pipe mucked out, materials delivered

materials.mucked-out pipe interior: silt shoveled into the wheelbarrow and tipped on the spoil pile at the left

checkpoints.title: Utility trench dug

The conduit's capped end pokes out of the ground and enters the pipe through a small hole low on the track-side flank. The conduit coil in the yard is smaller.
